snippet.title: FLESHBOUND – Official Trailer | Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
Wishlist FLESHBOUND on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3356440/Fleshbound/

FLESHBOUND is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration, tension, and environmental storytelling.
You arrive at a family home after its owners suddenly leave in a hurry. They only ask you to take care of a few things around the house.
Close the windows. Check the rooms. Follow the instructions they left behind.
But as the storm grows stronger, strange noises begin to echo through the house — and the notes you discover suggest that something happened here before you arrived.
Explore a dark and realistic family home during a violent storm, uncover its secrets, and survive the night.

Developed & Published by TrueGames

#FLESHBOUND #HorrorGame #PsychologicalHorror
